No application for costs will be considered outside this time frame without prior leave. || [33] In order to assist the parties with resolving costs themselves, I can indicate (subject to any submissions) that a tariff based approach to costs is likely. In which case the usual starting point would be around $3,000 (GST inclusive) per day. That figure would then be adjusted in light of the particular circumstances of this case.
